approval_source.question_set: Where the kit replacement drill runs (K4)

decisions.question: D10-Q03, D11-Q03
decisions.rule: The kit replacement drill (K4) runs in the CI staging network (the validator on the runner, the sentry and the endpoint in VMs) on every change, with the release's binaries, bundles and root helper. The staging chain gets five throwaway kits for its freeze, resume and upgrade keys, and a staging-only upgrade and handover notice of 20 blocks instead of 120,960. Production values are unchanged, and no real host is touched.

unset: A replacement drill on real hosts with the full notice
does_not_authorize: any run on a real host
